kjv: take the name of the LORD thy God in vain
mine: take up the name of Yahweh your God for falsehood
note: Hebrew nasa' ... la-shav' means to lift up/use the name for emptiness or falsehood (esp. false oaths, cf. shav' in v.20); "in vain" narrows it in modern ears to casual or profane speech.
Hebrew ratsach denotes unlawful, especially intentional homicide (it is the term for the "murderer" in Num 35); the law itself prescribes capital punishment and war, so "kill" is too broad.
